title: Reverse Rain — Manual Isolation at the Hydrology Vault
source_scope: Authorial scenario grounded in broad SCP topic and supplied reference; particular mechanics are not requester-owned locks.

pixel_priorities.criterion: Continuous pool-to-column-to-overhead-collector route; torn pool rises, downward-pointing droplet tails and upward splash jointly support upward water travel.
Two hands grip opposite sides of one reachable red handwheel; connected arms and supported stance are visible.
Handwheel stem/pipe passes through wet-dry partition and visibly connects to the partially closed collector shutter.
Transparent wet/dry boundary, bolted or sealed industrial chamber and control-side operator jointly read as anomalous containment.
The reference-guided fictional adult face and dark bob are legible, with gaze toward the water and concentrated urgency.

thematic_checks: SCP-style institutional anomalous containment is visually supported without relying on text alone.
A connected intervention and consequence creates procedural tension.
reference_checks: Compare only visible facial proportions, dark eyes, straight dark chin-length bob and separated fringe.
Actual identity and exact likeness are not established by a genre scene.

source_specific_checks.literal_final_text: At the near wet-side base of the partition, an unobscured knee-high steel inspection plate is deeply pitted in one palm-wide patch; glossy black wet film covers that patch, follows the plate's lower edge, and continues onto the floor immediately beneath it as a single connected smear, distinct from the distant pool. A raking edge light makes the pits and the film's continuous route readable.
full_pass_requires: R06-R1: deep irregular pitting visibly on metal plate
R06-R2: wet dark film visibly on same plate/edge
R06-R3: same film visibly continues from plate onto floor directly below
confusion_boundaries: Reflection, shadow or printed darkness does not establish pitting or material film.
Chemistry, lethality, exact fictional entity, history and elapsed time are unproved.

nonvisual_boundaries: No image can establish actual identity, actual age, biography or consent.
Canonical SCP identity, object class and exact procedure are not requested and cannot be certified.
A single still may make motion direction partially observable; partial or unobservable fails the full relation.
review_rule: For a relation, every component and connection must be visible together; partial/unobservable fails full case.
